cases.initial_keyboard_focus: Statistics initial Tab showed sidebar focus; seven Shift+Tab steps visibly outlined Feedback, GitHub, Restore, Language, Update, Startup, Skin in Studio primary. External links and Startup were not activated.
cases.language: Language focused: Return opens, Escape closes and returns to Language; Space opens, Escape closes, Tab reaches Restore with visible outline.
cases.skin_escape: Skin Space opens and Escape closes with visible Skin focus; Return also opens.
cases.skin_forward: Menu remained open after seven Tabs, eighth Tab closed it and focused Statistics sidebar.
cases.skin_reverse: From newly opened menu Shift+Tab closed it and visibly focused Feedback.
cases.theme_draft: Synthetic unsaved provider name and its two model rows survived Blue and Studio selections; both selections left menu open and appearance.json was read back as blue then studio_indigo.
cases.modal: Sync confirmation opened; clicking Skin position on scrim did not open skin menu or dismiss confirmation; Escape closed confirmation. No sync or restart executed.
cases.menu_samples: Before and after sampling, fresh CUA trees showed seven Skin options and Studio on; Language dialog and three options remained present after its sample.
cases.intermediate: 2aac failed visual toolbar outline; 4bed and 22f are intermediate only, not claimed as final evidence.

limitations: CUA focused element reports standard window; focus identity was verified via visible outlines and safe keyboard behavior, not external native AX attributes.
Comprehensive accessibility, IME and other control focus colors are not covered.
Menu idle samples are reported separately; 60-second observations do not establish long-term memory stability.
Baseline and intermediate menu CPU samples may have different theme and warm-session history; do not attribute RSS differences directly to this change.

main_agent_review.scope: Visible focus and real keyboard/pointer behavior. Native OS AX selected/focused attributes not queried or verified.
